title: Martial Law Order 1962 Zone B No 108

sections.shortTitle: Martial Law Order 1962 Zone B No 108
sections.section: ORDER - Martial Law Order 1962 (Zone B) No. 108
sections.description:
MARTIAL LAW REGULATION
MARTIAL LAW ORDERS
By
MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATOR ZONE `B'
No.108
[13th January 1962,
Gazette; of West Pakistan, Extraordinary, 16th January 1962]
In para. (3) of Martial Law Administrator, Zone `B' Order
No. 50, dated 20th November 1959, for the words and figures "3oth
November, 1959" the words and figures "31st March 1962"
shall be substituted, and shall be deemed always to have been so substituted.
